extension_name.description: The extension's name in Safari's settings and menus.

extension_description.message: Send web pages and PDFs from Safari to Rescriva, where you can mark them up, search them and rebuild them.
extension_description.description: What the extension does, in Safari's settings.

open_pdf.description: Popup button when the tab shows a PDF.

send_page.description: Popup button: save the page as a PDF in Rescriva.

send_page_hint.message: Saved as a PDF, as it looks now.
send_page_hint.description: Under the Send this page button.

send_link.description: Popup button: Rescriva downloads the address itself.

send_link_hint.message: Rescriva downloads it. Pages that need you to sign in may not come through.
send_link_hint.description: Under the Send the link button.

open_rescriva.description: Button shown after a send: opens the app, which imports what was sent.

open_in_rescriva.description: Context-menu item on links to PDFs (Safari on Mac).

sending.description: Status while a page or PDF is being handed over.

sent.message: Sent. It's in PDF Files when Rescriva opens.
sent.description: Status after a page or PDF was handed over.

sent_link.message: Link sent. Rescriva downloads it when it opens.
sent_link.description: Status after only the link was handed over.

cant_send.message: Only web pages and PDFs can go to Rescriva.
cant_send.description: Status on a tab with nothing to send (a new tab, a settings page).

open_yourself.message: Safari didn't open Rescriva. Open it yourself to see what you sent.
open_yourself.description: Status when Safari couldn't open the app.

error_no_app.message: Rescriva didn't answer. Open Rescriva once, then try again.
error_no_app.description: The extension couldn't reach its native half.

error_too_large.message: That file is too large to send to Rescriva.
error_too_large.description: A file over the size limit.

error_not_web.message: Rescriva can only open secure (https) web addresses.
error_not_web.description: The link to send isn't https, so Rescriva couldn't download it.

error_not_pdf.message: That link didn't lead to a PDF.
error_not_pdf.description: The downloaded file wasn't a PDF.

error_menu.description: Toolbar tooltip after the context-menu item failed.
